scene_name: Limited order entry with heterogeneous order selection
scene_goal: Validate whether the enterprise can diagnose insufficient effective order entry, develop one additional market when economically justified, and select advantageous feasible orders from deterministic market-bound offers.

day3: only two small pilot orders exist and normal operating capability is established
cash, material, staffing and production-line states do not dominate the later order-choice task
day5: the two pilot orders have formed a small closed-loop sales history
no additional prewarm market orders have been introduced
day10: one deterministic offer from the single active market is visible at takeover
recent order entry remains small relative to uncommitted finished goods
sales must infer whether another market is economically justified without a recommended action field
day20: at most one additional market is developed and only active markets unlock their bound offers
accepted orders favor feasible contribution over raw order count
realized contribution is competitive with the feasible order-combination oracle

evidence_focus: whether Agent and Scripted start from the same deterministic market-bound schedule
whether market development follows order-entry, inventory, backlog, cost and lead-time evidence
whether sales accepts high-value feasible orders and rejects dominated or infeasible orders
whether accepted quantity remains covered by inventory and deadline-adjusted production capacity
whether realized contribution margin and on-time fulfillment improve without avoidable breach penalties
whether the decision remains based on observation data rather than hidden case labels
